summary: Default macOS dev shells to Cargo debug=0 for dev and test profiles

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Dev-shell only; respects existing CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG/CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG values; Linux, CI and Cargo.toml profiles unchanged.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

manual.detail: Set CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG before entering the shell to keep debug info.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery steps.
